coverage_notes: This is BNB Beacon Chain (bnb1 bech32), separate from BSC/EVM.

Official documentation says Beacon Chain shut down at block 385251927 on 2024-12-03. Legacy dex history/head/time APIs fail; explorer /api/v1/txs remains available and its address filter was independently checked.

Explorer reports 9091625 address history records. Full retrieval is not feasible in this keyless shared-budget pass; exact missing block range is recorded. Latest 200 records are retained, with native and BEP-2 transfers and originator fees separated.

Full T-60..T+400 (clipped at fetch time) windows for each known designation and the latest 90 days are queried. These dates are after the documented chain shutdown; empty windows are backed by explicit explorer responses, not assumed.
Multi-send parent records with children are retained in raw responses but not treated as single wallet transfers; older multi-send history remains within the missing range.
The account snapshot is not proof of current spendability or asset-recovery balances on BSC. No recovery claim or transaction is attempted.

missing_intervals.reason: Exchange-scale full history not fetched; only latest 200 explorer records and full critical windows queried

fetch_status.meaning: provisional describes unfinished acquisition for the stated bounded study; complete describes whole-address history. Terminal privacy/provider gaps and window-only histories stay explicit exceptions. Neither false provisional nor a completed acquisition implies complete population coverage.

interpretation: Own-history pattern within data checked; never proof of a leak. Placebos and exchangeability failures qualify all pooled p values.
limitations: Live fetcher snapshot; unavailable chains/partial files are never inactive addresses.
Only native assets and explicit recognised token contracts valued; unrecognised tokens excluded.
Balance turnover requires full recognised-portfolio reconciliation; excluded assets are not zero.
Date-only OFAC publication: announcement-day activity excluded; no intraday advance-notice inference.
Time trends, serial dependence, seizures, indictments, earlier vendor publications and exchange collapses can confound results.
Permutation coupling is a dependence model, not exact inference under arbitrary action/entity time dependence.
OFAC names and identifiers only; destination labels do not establish historical ownership or misconduct.
Coverage append for docs/COVERAGE.md is supplied in PREMOVE.md; shared coverage file not owned.

method.cluster_method: connected components joining shared first-publication action OR entity
method.permutation_dependence: common-uniform empirical-quantile coupling within cluster; conditional diagnostic
